title: Resulting rectangular base
spec: Start by creating a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. Next, draw a two-dimensional sketch on a new face. This sketch will consist of a closed loop made up of four lines. The first line starts at the origin and ends at coordinates (0.005, 0.0). The second line continues from this point to (0.005, 0.005). The third line moves from there to (0.0, 0.005), and the fourth line completes the loop back to the origin. After drawing the loop, apply a scale factor of 0.005 to the entire sketch to adjust its size. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three-dimensional space by rotating it with Euler angles set to zero and translating it with a vector of zero. Finally, extrude the sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction to create a solid body. The dimensions of the resulting rectangular base are 0.005033557046979866 meters in length, 0.005033557046979866 meters in width, and 0.7500000000000001 meters in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0).lineTo(0.005, 0).lineTo(0.005, 0.005).lineTo(0, 0.005).close()

# Extrude the sketch to create the rectangular base
base = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# The final model is represented as 'r'
r = base
